article.title: OpenAI acquires startup Orchestra Bio⁠ to beef up its biotech business
article.summary: OpenAI says it's adding Orchestra's team and technology to work on Rosalind, its AI model for life sciences research, and to its related Rosalind Workbench tool, a harness that aims to help researchers plan experiments and analyze results.
